faq_items.question: What size should I print mountain wall art?
faq_items.answer: Print at a standard frame size so framing is easy. Print at 8x10 for an 11x14 matted frame, or 11x14 for a 16x20 matted frame. Always print at 100 percent or actual size, never fit to page, so the mountain proportions stay accurate.

faq_items.question: What kind of paper is best for printable wall art?
faq_items.answer: Use a heavier matte presentation paper or cardstock in the 32-lb to 65-lb range. It holds ink crisply, will not buckle inside a frame, and gives a gallery weight that thin copy paper cannot. Set your printer to its highest quality and a matte paper type.

faq_items.question: Can I print mountain wall art at home?
faq_items.answer: Yes. Any home inkjet or laser printer handles the letter-size PDF. For the sharpest result, print in grayscale on the best quality setting. If your printer only takes thin paper, an office-supply shop will print a single heavy sheet for well under a dollar.

faq_items.question: Is this mountain wall art really free?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The mountain line-art PDF downloads free with no account, no email sign-up, and no watermark. Print as many copies as you like for personal use, reprint whenever you restyle a room, and frame it in whatever size and finish suits your space.

faq_items.question: What colors and rooms does mountain line art work in?
faq_items.answer: Black line art on cream paper suits almost any room, bedroom, living room, office, entryway, or nursery, and reads as modern, Scandinavian, boho, and minimalist at once. For a softer look, reprint the same design in deep sage or charcoal instead of pure black.
